name: nthstock
description: Indian stock market platform (paper trading) built from scratch.

scripts.dev:api: npm run infra:up && VITE_API_MODE=api REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://127.0.0.1:6379} JWT_SECRET=${JWT_SECRET:-$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require('node:crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64url'))")} turbo run dev --env-mode=loose --filter=@nthstock/api --filter=@nthstock/realtime --filter=@nthstock/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
